svg.title: URL shortener: write once, read a thousand times
svg.desc: URL shortener architecture diagram showing the write path where a long URL is sent to the API, converted to a base 62 short code by an ID generator and stored, and the read path where a short code lookup hits the cache first and returns a 301 redirect, falling back to the database on a miss.

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The read path is the whole design. Writes are rare and can be slow.
